description:
The Demarco Studio - Cacti, salty swims, proximity to goings on, Nutrition to the soul...

The space
Welcome to The Music City! The stylish Demarco Studio is located in trendy Midtown Nashville, on the border of Downtown, Broadway, Music Row, The Parthenon, and Hillsboro Village. Our neighborhood features many chef-driven restaurants and bustling bars. It’s just moments from Vanderbilt Medical Center, Childrens Hospital, the VA Hospital, and Centennial Medical Complex. Its walkability and closeness to both downtown and other unique neighborhoods make it an exceptionally convenient area to stay in Nashville.

This unit is a 30~ minute walk/5-10 minute Uber to Broadway.

Amenities include:
· 1 King Bed
· 1 foldout sofa bed - Sleeps 2
· Hassle-free, keyless check-in and 24-hour building access
· 1 FREE secured parking spot in garage
· Smart TV
· High-speed internet
· SALTWATER Pool, outdoor patio with fire table & grill
· Entertainment lounge with pool table, co-working space and kitchen
· In-unit washer & dryer
· Iconic, highly walkable location in Midtown - near restaurants, shopping, bars & live music
· Fully equipped kitchen with appliances, glasses & dishware for all your cooking needs
· Electric coffee maker
· 5 minute Uber ride to Broadway
· Hair dryer, shampoo, conditioner, & body wash provided
· Linens and towels provided
· Spacious closet with hangers for storing your belonging
· Vacuum and extra cleaning supplies provided

Unfortunately, if you're looking to throw a rager, you'll need to look elsewhere as we have a zero tolerance policy on that kinda thing. The building is very peaceful and we aim to keep our relationship with the other residents amicable! We are permitted to sleep up to 6, but you'll need to bring an air mattress if that's your plan. Just message us ahead of time so we know what to expect. We love providing an affordable alternative to the overpriced hotels! 

This is a brand new unit, but you should totally read the reviews on our first unit which is in the same building and has the same exact floorplan *gasp*!! Happy to answer any questions you may have, so shoot us a message!

My wife and I live in the neighborhood and are always happy to give suggestions for restaurants and fun things to do in town upon request! We love this city and hope you enjoy your stay at our property! :)

Professional pictures of the property are coming soon, but I always appreciate compliments on my iPhone photography skills...

We do not host locals and will require all of our guests to send a photo of their ID upon booking for insurance reasons. Please keep this in mind when booking. We are legally unable to host anyone under the age of 21.

Other things to note
